newsitem.title: USA: Amer HealthChoice rehires CEO, raises $2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Amer HealthChoice rehires CEO, raises $2 mln.

text.p: American HealthChoice Inc said Wednesday that Dr. J.W. Stucki, who recently resigned as the company's chief executive officer, has agreed to step back in as CEO.
The company also said it has entered into an agreement with Wingate Financial Associates LLC to raise a minimum of two million dollars in equity funding for the company.
American HealthChoice said the financing will provide the necessary capital to allow the company to meet its operating needs for the next 12 months while it further refines its operations.
In early March the company said that it was considering selling some of its assets or pursing a merger.
American HealthChoice operates primary care clinics located in Texas, Louisiana and Georgia.
